title: LookML Model Validation Time p95
app: Looker LookML validator results and deploy events via the Looker API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=looker:lookml_validation status="success"
| eval dur_s=round(validation_ms/1000,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by model_name
| where p95_s>30
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile validation time for each model in LookML and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking LookML models by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest LookML timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest models with their owners.
visualization: Table of model by p95 validation time, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in LookML so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
